svg.aria-label: Surroundflix app window and toolbar popup

ol.li: In Safari > Settings > Advanced, tick “Show features for web developers”.
In Safari > Settings > Developer, tick “Allow unsigned extensions”. Safari turns this off each time it quits.
In Safari > Settings > Extensions, enable Surroundflix and allow it on netflix.com.

section.p: Choose between 5.1 and Atmos or 5.1 only with the Surroundflix button in Safari's toolbar.
Atmos titles play as 5.1 in Safari. Control Center shows “Multichannel”, with Spatial Audio and head tracking.

label.span: 5.1 only, if Atmos titles fail to play

main.p: Takes effect the next time you start a title.

section.p: Best audio Netflix sent: Dolby Atmos
